newsitem.title: USA: Texas power prices hold steady through the weekend.
newsitem.headline: Texas power prices hold steady through the weekend.

text.p: Bulk wholesale power prices in the Electric Reliability Council of Texas (ERCOT) were talked steady through the weekend and into Monday, industry sources said.
Support for the spot ERCOT power was seen from strong gas prices boosting electricity generation costs.
Weekend power normally priced at a discount to weekday power due to lower demand was said to holding at levels seen through this week, the brokers and marketers said.
Peak, firm power for weekend and Monday delivery was talked steady to higher at $29.00-31.50 from a Thursday discussion range of $27.00-30.00 per megawatt hour (MWh), the brokers and marketers said.
Off-peak ERCOT power for weekend and Monday delivery was pegged at $14.00-17.00 from a Thursday range of $20.00-22.00 per megawatt hour (MWh), the sources said.
December peak power was talked steady at $24.25-24.75, while January/February ERCOT power was talked at $25.25-25.50, the sources said.
-- Chris Reese, New York Power Desk 212-859-1627
